result.summary: This pull request replaces MSVC (cl.exe) with LLVM's clang-cl for native Windows builds and completely removes MSVC build support from CMake. It updates CMake presets, compiler flags, CI workflows, and documentation accordingly, while linking to the clang-cl runtime builtins library.
result.problem: MSVC suffers from recurring internal compiler errors that require custom workarounds, lacks inline assembly support on x64 and ARM64, and produces slower binaries with longer CI compilation times on Windows.

resolved_concerns: Addressed fanquake's concern about maintenance overhead of supporting both MSVC and clang-cl by completely dropping MSVC support
Resolved build breakages with clang-cl runtime builtins for 128-bit integer operations

result.card: This PR migrates native Windows builds from MSVC (cl.exe) to LLVM's clang-cl and completely removes support for MSVC. The change solves recurring MSVC internal compiler errors, supports inline assembly across architectures, cuts Windows CI run time by roughly 40%, and improves block connection benchmark throughput by over 50%. The PR is Concept ACKed by maintainers with no outstanding objections.
